name: Email Marketing Desk
creator: David Ndungu
description: Turns your product brief into an email strategy, complete lifecycle campaigns and a working preview. Reviews results and proposes the next test. Uses nine free, open-source skills; drafts first, with Saka business research optional.
starter_prompts: Build my first email program from this product brief.
Audit these emails and fix the highest-impact gap.
Review these results and propose one next experiment.
